import { STORY_ROOT, byText, checkA11y, expect, forceClick, gotoStory, test } from '../support';

test.describe('widget--default', () => {
	test.describe('default', () => {
		test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
			await gotoStory(page, 'widget--default');
		});

		test.afterEach(async ({ page }) => {
			await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
		});

		test('opens with a click', async ({ page }) => {
			await checkA11y(page, STORY_ROOT, {
				rules: { 'landmark-one-main': { enabled: false } },
			});

			// open it
			await byText(page, 'Open').click();
			await expect(page.getByRole('dialog')).toHaveCount(1);
			await forceClick(page.locator('button.close'));
			await expect(byText(page, /open/i)).toHaveCount(1);
			await expect(byText(page, /open/i)).toBeFocused();
		});
